evidence.ref: fixed aggregate directional feedback from the last measured candidate tab=6 delta_primary=0.0
prediction_api legal_context_access permits DV.load(split) for inference-time arrays such as tab
predict block currently returns SO.predict(model, Xs, split) with no slice correction

expected_observation: Predictions change only on tab=6 rows; if the slice weakness is real and item priors are stabilizing, marginal portfolio contribution should improve even with near-flat standalone score.

experiment_contract.claim: The code must test a tab=6-specific inference-time blend of parent score with a train-only item long_view prior to target portfolio slice weakness.
experiment_contract.expected_observable: Prediction hashes differ from parent only because tab=6 rows are adjusted; non-tab=6 rows remain identical.
experiment_contract.falsification_condition: No portfolio gain, or degradation indicating tab=6 weakness is not helped by conservative priors.
forbidden_shortcuts: using validation/test labels or post-exposure targets in prediction
applying a per-user constant shift that cannot affect within-user ranking
changing training or features under the guise of a predict-only slice mix
required_components: predict computes parent score via SO.predict
predict loads train split to estimate per-video long_view prior
predict loads target split to access tab and video_id
blend is applied only when tab==6

fallback: If tab-gated mixture is negative, abandon predict-only correction and pursue a stronger error-diverse branch such as a separate tree ranker or a train-time tab-conditioned model.
hypothesis: Because both current portfolio leaders are strongly disadvantaged on tab=6, injecting a conservative train-only item prior only on tab=6 will create useful error diversity and improve marginal portfolio contribution even if standalone gain is small.
implementation_plan: Edit only the predict block. Keep the trained parent model score from SO.predict(model, Xs, split), then load DV.load('train') and DV.load(split) inside predict to compute a train-only item long_view rate prior per video_id and a global fallback for unseen items. Construct a deterministic tab-gated convex mixture only for inference: for rows with tab==6, use alpha*model_score + (1-alpha)*item_prior with fixed alpha around 0.6; for all other tabs, return the original model score unchanged. No labels from valid/test are read, and the prior is constant across users only through the candidate item, so it can change within-user rankings across items.
justification: A slice-targeted, train-only mixture is a structural residual-targeted change aimed at portfolio diversity, satisfying the stagnation directive. Using tab and train-derived item prior changes (user,candidate-item) ordering on the problematic slice without touching forbidden feedback features.
mechanism: tab-specific prediction mixture between parent model and item-popularity prior
observation: Portfolio diagnostics show for w001 member_disadvantages on tab=6 delta_primary=-0.036711203406393667 and for w002 tab=6 delta_primary=-0.035760181511351796, while the overall fixed aggregate directional feedback from the last measured candidate had tab=6 delta_primary=0.0, indicating unresolved weakness on that slice. The prediction API explicitly permits custom predict code to call DV.load(split) for legal context such as tab.
research_nonuse_reason: This proposal is driven directly by portfolio slice diagnostics and the legal predict-time API, not by a supplied research mechanism. The goal is error diversity on a known weak slice rather than reproducing an external method.
risk: Item prior may be too coarse and hurt personalization within tab=6.
If tab=6 rows often contain repeated videos per user, the prior may add little ordering power.
A fixed alpha may be miscalibrated.
